name: Twin Fork Beer Co.
description: A family-run craft brewery and tasting room in Riverhead, started by twin brothers, with local bands or solo acts on most Sunday afternoons.

dancing.notes: Live music is mostly Sunday afternoon sets from about 2 to 5 PM, plus special band days such as a winter jam with three bands. We could not find out how much open floor there is or whether people dance.

evidence.note: Official site lists the address, hours and upcoming Sunday live music, such as Bear the Bell on Oct 4.
Event page: live music with Rodehauss on Sunday, Oct 11, 2026, 2-5 PM.
Local news: a ticketed Winter Jam at the brewery with three bands (Dead Ahead Band, NoFo Band, White Room) and a food truck.
